target.title: fix(twitch): time out Helix user resolution lookups
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users resolving Twitch targets could wait indefinitely when Helix user lookup requests stalled.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Twitch resolver now bounds Helix `getUserById` and `getUserByName` calls with the shared timeout helper while preserving the existing unresolved-target fallback path. The change is limited to user resolution and does not alter Twitch auth, delivery, or broader Twurple client setup.

This is an AI-assisted contribution prepared for Alix-007.

## User Impact

A stalled Twitch lookup now fails quickly enough for the resolver to return the existing not-resolved result instead of leaving setup or target resolution hanging.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/twitch/src/resolver.test.ts`
- Result: 1 test file passed, 2 tests passed.
- `git diff --check HEAD^ HEAD --`
- Result: passed.
## Proof

### 2026-07-13 exact-head controlled Twurple transport proof

- Exact PR head: `4f714316176c771441d2417db66f80106604dc35`.
- Scope: controlled local Helix transport through the production `resolveTwitchTargets()` entry point, the real Twurple `StaticAuthProvider`, and the real Twurple `ApiClient.users.getUserByName/getUserById` methods. Neither `@twurple/api` nor global fetch was mocked. This is not a live Twitch service outage.
- Harness: a temporary inline `node:http` server used Twurple 8.1.4's `TWURPLE_MOCK_API_PORT` transport hook. `/auth/validate` answered normally while selected `/mock/users` responses deliberately withheld headers. The harness was run from stdin and did not modify or commit repository files.
- Command:

  ```bash
  timeout 45s node --import tsx --input-type=module <<'EOF'
  <temporary local Twurple transport harness>
  EOF
  ```

- Redacted username transcript:

  ```text
  proof: exact-head=4f714316176c controlled local Twurple Helix transport
  twurple-mock-api: http://localhost:<redacted-port>/mock/users
  server: accepted mode=normal /auth/validate
  server: accepted mode=normal /mock/users?login=proofuser
  resolver: normal-before result=[{"input":"@proofuser","resolved":true,"id":"4242","name":"proofuser"}] elapsed=128ms
  server: accepted mode=normal /auth/validate
  server: accepted mode=stall /mock/users?login=proofuser
  resolver-error: Failed to resolve @proofuser: Twitch Helix user lookup timed out after 10000ms
  resolver: stalled-username result=[{"input":"@proofuser","resolved":false,"note":"API error: Twitch Helix user lookup timed out after 10000ms"}] elapsed=10007ms
  server: released /mock/users?login=proofuser after 9990ms
  server: accepted mode=normal /auth/validate
  server: accepted mode=normal /mock/users?login=proofuser
  resolver: normal-after result=[{"input":"@proofuser","resolved":true,"id":"4242","name":"proofuser"}] elapsed=11ms
  ```

- Redacted user-ID transcript:

  ```text
  server: accepted mode=normal /auth/validate
  server: accepted mode=stall /mock/users?id=4242
  resolver-error: Failed to resolve 4242: Twitch Helix user lookup timed out after 10000ms
  resolver: stalled-user-id result=[{"input":"4242","resolved":false,"note":"API error: Twitch Helix user lookup timed out after 10000ms"}] elapsed=10021ms
  server: released /mock/users?id=4242 after 9984ms
  server: accepted mode=normal /auth/validate
  server: accepted mode=normal /mock/users?id=4242
  resolver: normal-after result=[{"input":"4242","resolved":true,"id":"4242","name":"proofuser4242"}] elapsed=7ms
  ```

- Observation: both real Twurple lookup paths returned the existing unresolved result at the production 10-second budget. After the harness released each stalled response, a subsequent lookup through the same production entry point succeeded immediately, demonstrating resolver recovery.
- Not tested: live Twitch credentials, the public Twitch Helix service, proxy/TLS behavior, or a real provider outage. The caller-side timeout bounds OpenClaw's await but does not cancel Twurple's underlying fetch; the harness explicitly released each pending response after observing the fallback.
